question: Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more times than they have overtaken others on track during race laps, excluding position changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit), retirements, or position changes that occurred during the first lap of a race (considered as start movements).
sql:
WITH pit_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
lap_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        lp.race_id,
        lp.driver_id,
        lp.lap,
        lp.position,
        LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_position,
        LAG(lp.lap) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_lap,
        pl.lap AS pit_lap,
        rl.lap AS retirement_lap,
        sl.lap AS starting_lap
    FROM lap_positions lp
    LEFT JOIN pit_laps pl ON lp.race_id = pl.race_id AND lp.driver_id = pl.driver_id AND lp.lap = pl.lap
    LEFT JOIN lap_positions rl ON lp.race_id = rl.race_id AND lp.driver_id = rl.driver_id AND lp.lap = rl.lap
    LEFT JOIN lap_positions sl ON lp.race_id = sl.race_id AND lp.driver_id = sl.driver_id AND lp.lap = sl.lap
    WHERE lp.lap > 0
    AND lp.lap_type::TEXT NOT LIKE '%Retirement%'
    AND lp.lap_type::TEXT NOT LIKE '%Starting Position%'
    AND lp.position IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT race_id, lap, position, prev_position, pit_lap, prev_lap
FROM lap_changes
WHERE driver_id = 28
AND prev_position IS NOT NULL
AND (position < prev_position OR position > prev_position)  -- Only show position changes
ORDER BY race_id, lap

{"sql": "WITH pit_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
lap_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        lp.race_id,
        lp.driver_id,
        lp.lap,
        lp.position,
        LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_position,
        LAG(lp.lap) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_lap,
        pl.lap AS pit_lap,
        rl.lap AS retirement_lap,
        sl.lap AS starting_lap
    FROM lap_positions lp
    LEFT JOIN pit_laps pl ON lp.race_id = pl.race_id AND lp.driver_id = pl.driver_id AND lp.lap = pl.lap
    LEFT JOIN lap_positions rl ON lp.race_id = rl.race_id AND lp.driver_id = rl.driver_id AND lp.lap = rl.lap
    LEFT JOIN lap_positions sl ON lp.race_id = sl.race_id AND lp.driver_id = sl.driver_id AND lp.lap = sl.lap
    WHERE lp.lap > 0
    AND lp.lap_type::TEXT NOT LIKE '%Retirement%'
    AND lp.lap_type::TEXT NOT LIKE '%Starting Position%'
    AND lp.position IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT race_id, lap, position, prev_position, pit_lap, prev_lap
FROM lap_changes
WHERE driver_id = 28
AND prev_position IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY race_id, lap
LIMIT 50", "preview_rows": 50}
